format: Pint passed before tests; host Pint --dirty also passed
checked_behaviors: critical detection and safe queued context
600 second cooldown and expiration with controlled clock
four concurrent PHP processes produce one critical job
500ms inclusive slow query threshold, fifth occurrence, rolling 300 second window
HTTP 503 release, attempt 10 failure, HTTP 429 Retry-After
actual database worker retry and permanent failure do not produce recursive alerts
limitations: Real delivery tested on local Docker runtime, not production hosting.
Queue/cache depend on the database; database outages require external monitoring.
Critical logs without a Throwable share one fingerprint per environment.
Slack API acceptance recorded; no manual screenshot or user read receipt claimed.
